newsitem.title: UK: NWE OIL PRODUCTS FIRM, MOGAS SOARS $6 ON US GAINS.
newsitem.headline: NWE OIL PRODUCTS FIRM, MOGAS SOARS $6 ON US GAINS.

text.p: NWE oil products firmed on Thursday morning, led by gasoline which jumped $6 a tonne on U.S. gains of two cents a gallon on Wednesday.
Premium unleaded barges talked $226 fob for loading from Amsterdam or Rotterdam.
September swaps were pegged around $204, some $4 above late Wednesday levels.
Gas oil was up $2 a tonne in early trading in line with the IPE where September traded at $172 at 0824 GMT
Heavy fuel was little changed but some traders expected gains after strong bunker demand this week.
Talk was either side of $96 fob for barges depending on timing and quality.
